bibliographic.title: LLM-based Agents Suffer from Hallucinations: A Survey of Taxonomy, Methods, and Directions

relevance_to_mlgg: Taxonomy of hallucination in LLM-based agents at different pipeline stages. Identifies 18 underlying causes. Directly relevant to MLGG's agentic extraction workflow.
key_findings: Agent hallucinations differ from raw LLM hallucinations (tool use, planning, memory)
18 distinct causes across perception, reasoning, action stages
Stage-specific mitigation more effective than generic approaches
actionable_for_mlgg: Classify extraction errors by stage: input parsing, reasoning, output formatting
Address perception hallucination: ensure paper text is correctly parsed before extraction
Address action hallucination: validate extracted values match schema constraints
